text: 银行再秀肌肉，青岛银行罕见涨超8%，四大行市值首创10万亿！银行ETF华宝（512800）标的指数再涨2%
text_en: Banks flex their muscles again, Qingdao Bank unusually rose more than 8%, and the combined market value of the four major banks topped RMB 10 trillion for the first time! The underlying index of Bank ETF Huabao (512800) rose another 2%
